messages:
jin: Sundial-v0.2 q6 bringup — seeing a consistent BLEU drop on a small vertical-JP smoke set when there are embedded Arabic quotes and ruby furigana. Anyone seen this pattern?

amanda: Can you paste a sample input/output and the eval diff?

jin: sure, here's a minimal repro (staged):
```
INPUT (vertical line order preserved):
漢字[ふりがな]{ruby}«العربية»

REF TRANSLATION: "Kanji (furigana) «Arabic»"
SUNDIAL-v0.1 (gold): "Kanji (furigana) «Arabic»"
SUNDIAL-v0.2-q6: "Kanji«Arabic» (furigana)"

Eval: BLEU: 27.4 -> 24.1 (−3.3)
```

leo: looks like tokens are being shuffled around near the ruby boundary + bidi anchors. Are we inserting/removing a joiner or ZWSP?

jin: local token counts: v0.1 -> 9 tokens, q6 -> 7 tokens for this example. Suspect normalization/merge step collapsed the furigana marker with adjacent glyphs.

ml-ci-bot: CI: sundial-v0.2-q6 smoke summary: BLEU −3.2, chrF −1.7, sample_failures 12 (out of 500)

amanda: assigning triage: @leo @ops-jen please reproduce on staging, run a token-level diff and attach tokenizer trace. Priority: high for locale regressions.

leo: on it. repro command?

jin: repro command (staging):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"sundial-v0.2-q6","input":"漢字[ふりがな]{ruby}«العربية»","options":{"vertical":true}}' https://inference.staging.redwood/api/v1/generate | jq .
```

ops-jen: reproduced on staging. Tokenizer trace shows U+202F (narrow no-break space) and ZWJ positions shifted: ZWSP moved from after the kanji to before the furigana token in q6. Diff snippet:
```
TOKS v0.1: [漢字][ZWSP][ruby-open][ふりがな][ruby-close][«][العربية][»]
TOKS q6  : [漢字][ruby-open][ふりがな][ZWSP][«][العربية][»]
```

amanda: is this from tokenizer changes or the quant kernel? Which PR touched tokenizer recently?

leo: grepped history — tokenizer normalization PR merged ~1769997000 by @sara; q6 build also included a kernel reorder in the inference runtime. Need 2-way bisect: toggle tokenizer normalization vs q6 kernel.

jin: quick check: running with TOKENIZER_LEGACY=1 (force old normalization) + q6 binary yields BLEU 27.0 locally (+2.9 vs failing run). So turning off the tokenizer tweak largely fixes the smoke.

amanda: :thumbsup: plan — revert normalization tweak for the sundial-canary (or add opt-out), run full locale eval, and add a regression test for vertical + ruby + RTL mixing. Also file an issue with traces.

jin: opening ticket and adding logs: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-3245 — will PR a regression test and opt-out flag.

ml-ci-bot: Created INF-3245: "sundial-q6 vertical ruby + RTL tokenization regression" and kicked off extended-locale-smoke job.
